answer: Staked identity deposits: each agent locks a scarce, verifiable resource (coins) to its identity, slashed if peers prove it is a fake. Like copper wired through a relay, every claim carries a real cost. A sybil attacker must repeat this stake per fake agent until the expense reaches its zenith and the attack costs more than the reward; honest agents simply hold their stake and bend like a willow under pressure, returning to earn each epoch.
